en.name: Fruit
en.subtitle: Taiwan's fruit, season by season — how to pick it and when it's at its best.

zh.name: 水果
zh.subtitle: 台灣四季鮮果——怎麼挑、何時最對味。

en.name: Apple
en.desc: Crisp and sweet-tart, on hand year-round; Fuji (富士) is the popular sweet, juicy type. Mostly imported, with some grown high in the mountains (梨山). Store apart from other fruit — it ripens them fast.
en.tip: Refrigerate in the crisper to stay crisp for weeks; bring to room temperature for the fullest flavor.

zh.name: 蘋果
zh.desc: 清脆酸甜、四季常備；富士蘋果香甜多汁最受歡迎。多為進口，部分產於梨山高山。會催熟其他水果，宜分開存放。
zh.tip: 放冰箱蔬果室可保持脆度數週；回溫後風味最佳。

en.name: Banana
en.desc: Soft and sweet; Taiwan's highland bananas (山蕉) are especially fragrant. Eat out of hand, or fry as a snack.
en.tip: Keep at room temperature; never refrigerate — the cold blackens the skin. Sit them apart so they don't bruise.

zh.name: 香蕉
zh.desc: 軟甜順口，台灣山蕉香氣足。直接食用或炸香蕉皆可。
zh.tip: 室溫保存、切勿冷藏，低溫會使外皮變黑。分開放置以免壓傷。

en.name: Guava
en.desc: Crisp and lightly sweet, eaten firm. The pearl guava (珍珠芭樂) is the everyday crunchy type; often dipped in sour-plum powder (甘梅粉).
en.tip: Refrigerate ripe ones in a bag; eat within a few days while still crisp.

zh.name: 芭樂
zh.desc: 清脆微甜，喜吃脆口。珍珠芭樂最常見；常沾甘梅粉食用。
zh.tip: 熟果裝袋冷藏，趁脆數日內食用。

en.name: Wax apple
en.desc: Bell-shaped, crisp and watery with a delicate sweetness. The dark-red 'black pearl' (黑珍珠) from Pingtung is the prized type.
en.tip: Very perishable — bag and refrigerate, and eat within two to three days.

zh.name: 蓮霧
zh.desc: 鐘形、清脆多水、甜味淡雅。屏東黑珍珠最受推崇。
zh.tip: 極不耐放——裝袋冷藏，二、三日內食用完。

en.name: Dragon fruit
en.desc: Mildly sweet with crunchy seeds; red-fleshed types are sweeter and stain deeply. Best chilled before eating.
en.tip: Keep whole in the fridge up to a week; once cut, cover and eat the same day.

zh.name: 火龍果
zh.desc: 甜度溫和、籽粒爽脆；紅肉品種更甜、汁液染色重。冰鎮後更好吃。
zh.tip: 整顆冷藏可放約一週；切開後加蓋當日食用。

en.name: Mango
en.desc: Fragrant and sweet, peaking in summer. Aiwen (愛文) is small and red with silky flesh; Jinhuang (金煌) is large and golden. Eat fresh or over shaved ice (芒果冰).
en.tip: Ripen at room temperature until fragrant and yielding, then refrigerate to slow it down.

zh.name: 芒果
zh.desc: 香甜多汁，盛產於夏季。愛文小而紅、果肉細滑；金煌大而金黃。鮮食或做芒果冰皆宜。
zh.tip: 室溫催熟至散發香氣、按壓微軟，再冷藏延緩熟成。

en.name: Pineapple
en.desc: Sweet-tart and juicy; the Golden Diamond (金鑽) variety is low in acid and barely bites the tongue. Year-round, best spring to summer; also the filling in pineapple cakes (鳳梨酥).
en.tip: Ripens little after picking — keep at room temperature a day or two, then refrigerate cut chunks.

zh.name: 鳳梨
zh.desc: 酸甜多汁，金鑽鳳梨甜度高、不咬舌。全年皆有、春夏最佳；也是鳳梨酥的內餡。
zh.tip: 採後幾乎不再變甜——室溫放一兩天，切塊後冷藏。

en.name: Papaya
en.desc: Soft orange flesh, sweet and musky. Eaten ripe with a squeeze of lime, or blended with milk (木瓜牛奶).
en.tip: Ripen on the counter until mostly orange, then refrigerate and eat within days.

zh.name: 木瓜
zh.desc: 橙色果肉柔軟、香甜。可擠檸檬鮮食，或打成木瓜牛奶。
zh.tip: 室溫放至轉橙再冷藏，數日內食用。

en.name: Ponkan
en.desc: Loose-skinned and easy to peel, sweet and juicy — the everyday winter orange.
en.tip: Keep cool and airy, or refrigerate loosely bagged; skip airtight wrap, which traps moisture.

zh.name: 椪柑
zh.desc: 皮鬆好剝、甜美多汁，是冬季的日常柑橘。
zh.tip: 陰涼通風或鬆裝冷藏；避免密封，以免悶出水氣。

en.name: Tankan
en.desc: Tight-skinned and richly sweet-tart, ripening around Lunar New Year — hence its 'lucky New Year orange' name.
en.tip: Stores well cool and dry for a couple of weeks; refrigerate to stretch it further.

zh.name: 桶柑
zh.desc: 皮較緊實、酸甜濃郁，農曆年前後盛產，又稱「年柑」。
zh.tip: 陰涼乾燥可放約兩週；冷藏可保存更久。

en.name: Pomelo
en.desc: Large autumn citrus with thick rind and firm, sweet segments. Tied to the Mid-Autumn Festival.
en.tip: Keeps for weeks at cool room temperature; the thick rind protects the flesh, so no need to refrigerate whole.

zh.name: 柚子
zh.desc: 秋季大型柑橘，皮厚、果肉緊實清甜。與中秋節密不可分。
zh.tip: 陰涼室溫可放數週；厚皮護果肉，整顆無需冷藏。

en.name: Lemon
en.desc: Green and intensely sour in Taiwan; juiced into drinks or squeezed over food rather than eaten on its own.
en.tip: Refrigerate in a sealed bag to keep them juicy for weeks; zest before juicing if you need the peel.

zh.name: 檸檬
zh.desc: 台灣多為綠皮、酸度高；榨汁調飲或擠在食物上，少直接食用。
zh.tip: 密封冷藏可保多汁數週；需用皮時先刨皮再榨汁。

en.name: Kumquat
en.desc: Tiny and eaten whole — sour flesh, sweet skin. Made into kumquat tea and preserves.
en.tip: Refrigerate in a vented bag; eat within a week or two, or simmer into preserves.

zh.name: 金桔
zh.desc: 嬌小整顆食用——果肉酸、果皮甜。常做金桔茶與蜜餞。
zh.tip: 裝透氣袋冷藏，一兩週內食用，或熬煮成蜜餞。

en.name: Lychee
en.desc: Summer's jewel — fragrant, translucent and very sweet beneath a red shell. Best eaten the day it's picked; Yu-he-bao (玉荷包) is the prized variety.
en.tip: Eat the day you buy them; otherwise refrigerate in a bag — the shells brown fast but the flesh keeps a few days.

zh.name: 荔枝
zh.desc: 夏季珍果——紅殼下果肉晶瑩、香甜濃郁。最好現採現吃；玉荷包為名種。
zh.tip: 最好當日食用；否則裝袋冷藏，外殼易褐變但果肉可放數日。

en.name: Longan
en.desc: Lychee's cousin, smaller and milder. Dried into 桂圓 for teas and sweet soups.
en.tip: Refrigerate fresh ones in a bag for several days; the dried form (桂圓) keeps for months in a sealed jar.

zh.name: 龍眼
zh.desc: 荔枝的近親，較小而清甜；曬乾成桂圓，用於茶飲與甜湯。
zh.tip: 新鮮龍眼裝袋冷藏數日；桂圓乾密封可存數月。

en.name: Grape
en.desc: Kyoho (巨峰) is the common deep-purple table grape — sweet, slip-skin and seeded. Harvested twice a year.
en.tip: Refrigerate unwashed in their bag; rinse only just before eating to avoid mold.

zh.name: 葡萄
zh.desc: 巨峰葡萄最常見，深紫、皮肉易分、帶籽香甜。一年兩收。
zh.tip: 不清洗連袋冷藏；食用前再沖洗，以免發霉。

en.name: Persimmon
en.alt: 柿子 / 甜柿 / 柿餅
en.desc: Autumn fruit: sweet persimmons (甜柿) eaten crisp and firm, or astringent ones dried into chewy 柿餅.
en.tip: Keep crisp sweet persimmons cool and firm; ripen astringent ones until soft, or they'll pucker the mouth.

zh.name: 柿子
zh.desc: 秋季水果：甜柿脆口直接吃，澀柿則製成柔韌的柿餅。
zh.tip: 甜柿保持陰涼脆口；澀柿需放軟脫澀，否則口感澀麻。

en.name: Asian pear
en.desc: Crisp, juicy and refreshing, eaten cold. High-mountain pears are the sweetest.
en.tip: Refrigerate and eat chilled; cushion them, as the crisp flesh bruises easily.

zh.name: 水梨
zh.desc: 清脆多汁、爽口回甘，冰鎮食用。高山水梨最甜。
zh.tip: 冷藏後冰涼食用；果肉脆嫩易傷，宜分隔防碰撞。

en.name: Sugar apple
en.desc: Knobbly green skin over creamy, custard-sweet flesh; a Taitung specialty. Ripen on the counter, then chill before eating.
en.tip: Ripen on the counter until it gives to a gentle press, then refrigerate — once soft it spoils fast.

zh.name: 釋迦
zh.desc: 凹凸綠皮、果肉如卡士達般綿甜，台東名產。室溫催熟後冷藏更佳。
zh.tip: 室溫放至輕壓微軟再冷藏；變軟後不耐放，要儘快食用。

en.name: Loquat
en.desc: Small, downy and golden in spring; mild sweet-tart flesh around large seeds. Soothing for the throat.
en.tip: Delicate and bruise-prone — refrigerate in a single layer and eat within a few days.

zh.name: 枇杷
zh.desc: 春季金黃小果、表皮帶絨毛；果肉酸甜溫和、籽大。潤喉佳果。
zh.tip: 嬌嫩易碰傷——單層冷藏，數日內食用。
